definition: Count consecutive axis-heading changes in a nonempty finite path. Initial alignment excluded; reversal counts one change event, not a quarter-turn count. Stationary singleton gives0. Reject empty, malformed, repeated, diagonal or nonfinite segments. Count is invariant to straight-segment subdivision.
integration: Add directionChanges to the existing result table only. Use returned worldPath on ROUTE_FOUND, otherwise null. Export the existing result for recording the actual returned path without a second search. Search priorities, algorithms, body, clearance, budgets, goal and message remain unchanged.
executionMethod: Import committed practice CLI once per case; record its console table and exported result path. Valid case uses saved input. Invalid case substitutes goal only in memory and resolves the original module/data URLs before import, with no tracked input writes. Capture structured path on the diagnostic stream. These are known-map controls, not new samples.
checks: Archive only the five new metric tests. Match old status/length/expanded/path references, independently recount changes from recorded vectors and length from segment distances, ensure failed path gets null and its existing warning remains. Check old source/raw hashes. No full old101-test repeat or independent BFS planned.
scope: Geometric descriptor only, not orientation-aware planning, turn optimization, a kinematic/controller model or runtime/energy/physical evidence. Student hand-counts are separate from AI code, tests, operation and validation.
